name: n_starts
description: stage 0: random starts of the multistart (all parameters free; log-uniform in the parameter bounds)

name: seed
description: seed of every random draw (multistart starts; structural realizations; bootstrap resamples)

name: structural_q
description: structural identifiability: number of random parameter vectors (Stigter and Molenaar 2015)

name: structural_tol
description: structural identifiability: a singular value below this fraction of the largest is a structural zero

name: rank_tol
description: practical identifiability: a singular value of the weighted sensitivity matrix below this fraction of the largest makes the Fisher information rank deficient

name: corr_threshold
description: practical identifiability: parameter pairs with |r| above this are correlated

name: lr_alpha
description: confidence level of the likelihood-ratio threshold (profile likelihood)

name: bootstrap_n
description: number of case-bootstrap resamples (conditions drawn with replacement)

name: bootstrap_ci_ratio
description: bootstrap: a parameter is practically identifiable if the ratio of its 97.5 and 2.5 percentiles is at most this

name: bootstrap_local_starts
description: bootstrap: local starts per resample besides the warm start (free parameters at the estimate times 10**U(-span; span)); the best fit is kept; 0 = warm start only

name: bootstrap_local_span
description: bootstrap: decades on each side of the estimate covered by the local starts

name: profile_points
description: profile likelihood: points on each side of the estimate

name: profile_span
description: profile likelihood: decades covered on each side of the estimate

name: profile_extra_starts
description: profile likelihood: extra starts per point besides the warm continuation (other free parameters at the previous point times 10**U(-span; span)); the best fit is kept

name: profile_extra_span
description: profile likelihood: decades on each side of the previous point covered by the extra starts

name: bootstrap_profile_seeds
description: bootstrap: starts per resample drawn at random from the profile points within the likelihood-ratio threshold (full theta of the point)

name: out_dir
description: default output directory (relative to the repo root)
